Class SecretScreenMask

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.internal.image.SecretScreenMask
public final class SecretScreenMask extends Object
Keeps typed secrets out of the screenshots SHAFT publishes (#7175).

An element that received a secret (typed with typeSecure, or text holding a registered secret value or a JWT-shaped token) is registered for the current thread. Every evidence capture then hides that element's text while the element is on the page: on the web its text is made transparent for the capture and restored afterwards; on native mobile the element's rectangle is painted black, and the capture is dropped when the field is scrollable or its text can wrap outside that rectangle (#7282); in Playwright the locator is passed as a screenshot mask. When hiding fails while a secret element is still live, the capture is dropped rather than published.
